freshResume.confirm.description: Button of the question when Resume is pressed on a conversation that cannot continue (HI-2540): starts a new conversation instead.

freshResume.detail.defaultMessage: {assistant, select, yes {The Assistant starts a new conversation instead, and the old one stays in its conversations to read.} other {{agent} starts a new conversation instead. It carries on the agent's work (its watch, messages and tasks), and the old conversation stays in Sessions to read.}}
freshResume.detail.description: Under the question when Resume is pressed on a conversation that cannot continue (HI-2540): what starting a new one does. assistant yes: the Combwork Assistant (its conversations: the list in its panel); other: an agent ({agent}: its name). Sessions is a tab of the window: keep it as the window names it.

freshResume.message.defaultMessage: {why, select, moved {This conversation ran in a folder that moved to .combwork with its old data folder, so it can't continue there.} other {This conversation started before Combwork renamed the tools agents use, so it can't continue.}}
freshResume.message.description: The question when Resume is pressed on a conversation that cannot continue (HI-2540): why. moved: its folder moved to .combwork with the old data folder, from before 1.1 (keep .combwork as it is); other: Combwork renamed the tools agents use since it started.

freshResume.short.description: A conversation in a session picker that cannot continue (HI-2540): resuming it starts a new one. Lower case: it follows how long ago it ran.

freshResume.tip.defaultMessage: {why, select, moved {Starts a new conversation: "{session}" ran in a folder that moved to .combwork with its old data folder, so it can't continue} other {Starts a new conversation: "{session}" is from before Combwork renamed the tools agents use, so it can't continue}}
freshResume.tip.description: Tooltip of a Resume button whose conversation ({session}: its name) cannot continue (HI-2540): pressing it starts a new one. moved: its folder moved to .combwork with the old data folder (keep .combwork as it is); other: the tools agents use were renamed since.

freshResume.title.description: Title of the question when Resume is pressed on a conversation that cannot continue (HI-2540): a new one starts instead.
